summary: CWE-601 Open Redirect: untrusted data read from a socket flows into response.sendRedirect() in badSink unchanged, letting an attacker redirect users to an arbitrary external site. Fix in the sink (72b) by validating the already-parsed URI and requiring the target to be a site-local relative path (leading '/', no scheme, no authority, and not a protocol-relative '//...' URL) before redirecting. Legitimate relative redirects still work; off-site targets are rejected with the existing error response.
